notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla ships the full Need/Greed/Pass roll dialog family (4 stacked DIALOG popups, BoP gold-backdrop swap, CONFIRM_LOOT_ROLL popup, 60s timer bar, START/CANCEL/UPDATE_LOOT_ROLL driver). MSUIClient has no group-loot roll surface at all: no roll dialog, no LOOT_ROLL/START_ROLL/ALL_PASSED opcodes in Net/Opcodes.cs, no CMSG_LOOT_ROLL sender. The only trace is the UiParent managed-frame placement row (UiParentManagedConsumer.GroupLoot, BaseY 60) waiting for a consumer, plus CMSG_LOOT_METHOD (setting the group loot method) in WorldSession.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: The UiParentUiLaw GroupLoot placement definition suggests the surface was planned; everything user-visible is still to build.
